notes:
Summary: Mid-market SaaS (customer knowledge/search) evaluating Redwood Hosted API for embeddings and semantic search, with clear intent to move to Dedicated if throughput/costs justify. Primary goal: replace current hybrid approach (open-source embedder + managed vector DB) to reduce ops overhead and improve unit economics.

POC details:
- Data: ~2.3M indexed documents (tickets + KB articles + product docs), current weekly batch ingest of ~150k new embeddings.
- Integration: prototype uses Postgres + PGVector; interested in turnkey connectors to managed vector DBs or Redwood caching to cut costs.
- Throughput targets: 200 qps for batched similarity search during peak; 2k qps offline batch embed job throughput (parallel workers).
- Latency target for single-query semantic search: p50 < 60ms, p95 < 200ms (including nearest-neighbor lookup).
- Cost sensitivity: high — goal to reduce embedding unit cost by 30% vs current provider across high-volume batch runs.

Security / compliance notes:
- Must support SSO/SAML for console, audit logging retention 1 year, KMS integration for keys, and residency in US/EU respectively for certain customers. Security team asked for topology + KMS/HSM diagram (shared drive link above).

Quotes / call snippets:
- "We want to test hosted first — if we can hit throughput/cost targets we'll evaluate a Dedicated commit for predictable pricing." — VP Product
- "Major blocker is proving vector DB compatibility; don't want to be locked into a single vendor." — Lead Infra Engineer

Technical observations from SE (Marco Ruiz):
- Hosted API embeddings: latency and quality look good on 10k sample; embedding batch throughput limited by client-side batching now, need to run Dedicated-backed test to prove sustained throughput for 2k qps jobs.
- Consider using Redwood's batching + cache layer to amortize token costs during bulk re-embeds.

Next steps (short):
- Deliver Dedicated throughput baseline run week of 2026-03-17 (Marco) — include end-to-end: embed generation + vector ingest + similarity queries.
- Finance to review Dedicated pricing vs hosted for 12-month commit (Aisha to send model).
- Security to receive KMS/HSM diagram and SOC2/ISO artifacts (linked in drive).
